examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب خوارزمية البحث الثنائي الفعالة على مصفوفة مرتبة.
examples.descEn: Learn the efficient binary search algorithm on a sorted array.
examples.code:
%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    Array = {1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13},
    Target = 7,
    case binary_search(Target, Array, 1, tuple_size(Array)) of
        {ok, Index} -> io:format("Found ~p at index ~p~n", [Target, Index]);
        not_found -> io:format("~p not found~n", [Target])
    end.

binary_search(_, _, Low, High) when Low > High -> not_found;
binary_search(Target, Array, Low, High) ->
    Mid = (Low + High) div 2,
    MidVal = element(Mid, Array),
    if
        MidVal =:= Target -> {ok, Mid};
        MidVal > Target -> binary_search(Target, Array, Low, Mid - 1);
        true -> binary_search(Target, Array, Mid + 1, High)
    end.

%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    Tree = insert(insert(insert(insert(nil, 5), 3), 8), 1),
    io:format("In-order: "),
    inorder(Tree),
    io:format("~n").

insert(nil, X) -> {node, X, nil, nil};
insert({node, V, L, R}, X) when X < V -> {node, V, insert(L, X), R};
insert({node, V, L, R}, X) -> {node, V, L, insert(R, X)}.

inorder(nil) -> ok;
inorder({node, V, L, R}) ->
    inorder(L),
    io:format("~p ", [V]),
    inorder(R).

%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    N = 29, % 11101 في الثنائي

count_bits(0) -> 0;
count_bits(N) ->

    1 + count_bits(N band (N - 1)).

examples.code:
%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    List = [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90],
    Sorted = bubble_sort(List),
    io:format("Sorted list: ~p~n", [Sorted]).

bubble_sort(List) ->
    bubble_sort(List, length(List)).

bubble_sort(List, 0) -> List;
bubble_sort(List, N) ->
    Passed = pass(List),
    bubble_sort(Passed, N - 1).

pass([X, Y | Rest]) when X > Y -> [Y | pass([X | Rest])];
pass([X | Rest]) -> [X | pass(Rest)];
pass([]) -> [].

examples.descEn: Encrypts an English message by shifting letters 3 places, teaching list and map operations.

%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    Msg = "HELLO",
    io:format("~ts~n", [caesar(Msg, 3)]).

caesar(Str, Shift) ->
    lists:map(fun(C) -> shift_char(C, Shift) end, Str).

shift_char(C, Shift) when C >= $A, C =< $Z ->
    %% نطبق الإزاحة مع الالتفاف داخل نطاق الحروف الكبيرة
    $A + ((C - $A + Shift) rem 26);
shift_char(C, _) -> C.

factorize(N) -> factorize(N, 2, []).
factorize(1, _, Acc) -> lists:reverse(Acc);
factorize(N, D, Acc) when N rem D =:= 0 ->
    factorize(N div D, D, [D|Acc]);
factorize(N, D, Acc) -> factorize(N, D+1, Acc).

%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    Graph = [{a, [b, c]}, {b, [d]}, {c, []}, {d, []}],
    io:format("DFS from a: "),
    dfs(Graph, a, []),
    io:format("~n").

dfs(Graph, Node, Visited) ->
    case lists:member(Node, Visited) of
        true -> ok;
        false ->
            io:format("~p ", [Node]),
            Neighbors = proplists:get_value(Node, Graph, []),
            lists:foreach(fun(N) -> dfs(Graph, N, [Node | Visited]) end, Neighbors)
    end.

%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    Target = 42,
    guess(1, 100, Target).

guess(Low, High, Target) when Low =< High ->
    Mid = (Low + High) div 2,
    io:format("Is it ~p?~n", [Mid]),
    if
        Mid =:= Target -> io:format("Found!~n");
        Mid < Target -> guess(Mid+1, High, Target);
        true -> guess(Low, Mid-1, Target)
    end.

%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    T0 = [],
    T1 = put(T0, "name", "Alice"),
    T2 = put(T1, "age", 30),
    io:format("name: ~ts~n", [get(T2, "name")]),
    io:format("age: ~p~n", [get(T2, "age")]),
    io:format("missing: ~p~n", [get(T2, "city")]).

put([], K, V) -> [{K, V}];
put([{K, _} | T], K, V) -> [{K, V} | T];
put([H | T], K, V) -> [H | put(T, K, V)].

get([], _) -> undefined;
get([{K, V} | _], K) -> V;
get([_ | T], K) -> get(T, K).

%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).

main(_) ->

    List = [12, 11, 13, 5, 6],
    Sorted = insertion_sort(List),

insertion_sort([]) -> [];
insertion_sort([Head | Tail]) ->
    insert(Head, insertion_sort(Tail)).

insert(Element, []) -> [Element];
insert(Element, [Head | Tail]) when Element =< Head -> [Element, Head | Tail];
insert(Element, [Head | Tail]) -> [Head | insert(Element, Tail)].

%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    List = [5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2],
    Target = 8,
    case linear_search(Target, List) of
        {ok, Index} -> io:format("Found ~p at index ~p~n", [Target, Index]);
        not_found -> io:format("~p not found~n", [Target])
    end.

linear_search(_, []) -> not_found;
linear_search(Target, [Head|Tail]) ->
    case Head =:= Target of
        true -> {ok, 0};
        false ->
            case linear_search(Target, Tail) of
                {ok, Index} -> {ok, Index + 1};
                not_found -> not_found
            end
    end.

%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    io:format("~p~n", [fib(10)]).

fib(N) -> fib(N, #{0 => 0, 1 => 1}).

fib(N, Memo) ->
    case maps:find(N, Memo) of
        {ok, V} -> V;
        error ->
            % نحسب القيمةَ ونخزّنها في الخريطة
            V = fib(N-1, Memo) + fib(N-2, Memo),
            V
    end.

examples.descAr: يتعلّم الطالب أن Erlang لا يملك null، لكنه يستخدم الذرّة undefined للدلالة على غياب القيمة، وكيف يتحقق منها قبل الاستعمال.
examples.descEn: Learn that Erlang has no null but uses the atom undefined to indicate absence, and how to check it before use.
examples.code:
%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    MaybeValue = undefined,
    case MaybeValue of
        undefined -> io:format("No value~n");
        Value -> io:format("Value: ~p~n", [Value])
    end.

examples.descEn: Learn to generate Pascal's triangle rows using recursion and list comprehensions.
examples.code:
%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    Rows = 5,
    lists:foreach(fun(R) -> io:format("~p~n", [pascal_row(R)]) end, lists:seq(0, Rows-1)).

pascal_row(0) -> [1];
pascal_row(N) ->
    Prev = pascal_row(N-1),
    [1 | [lists:nth(I, Prev) + lists:nth(I+1, Prev) || I <- lists:seq(1, length(Prev)-1)] ++ [1]].

examples.code:
%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    Perfects = [N || N <- lists:seq(1, 100), is_perfect(N)],
    io:format("Perfect numbers up to 100: ~p~n", [Perfects]).

is_perfect(N) ->
    N > 1 andalso lists:sum(divisors(N)) =:= N.

divisors(N) -> [D || D <- lists:seq(1, N div 2), N rem D =:= 0].

examples.descEn: Learn to write a recursive function to check primality using trial division.
examples.code:
%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    N = 29,
    io:format("~p is prime: ~p~n", [N, is_prime(N)]),
    N2 = 15,
    io:format("~p is prime: ~p~n", [N2, is_prime(N2)]).

is_prime(N) when N < 2 -> false;
is_prime(N) -> is_prime(N, 2).
is_prime(N, D) when D*D > N -> true;
is_prime(N, D) when N rem D =:= 0 -> false;
is_prime(N, D) -> is_prime(N, D+1).
examples.expectedStdout:
29 is prime: true
15 is prime: false

examples.descEn: Learn to implement a queue using two lists, enqueue and dequeue efficiently.
examples.code:
%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    Q0 = {[], []},
    Q1 = enqueue(Q0, 1),
    Q2 = enqueue(Q1, 2),
    Q3 = enqueue(Q2, 3),
    {Front, Q4} = dequeue(Q3),
    io:format("Front: ~p~n", [Front]),
    {Next, _} = dequeue(Q4),
    io:format("Next: ~p~n", [Next]).

enqueue({In, Out}, X) -> {[X | In], Out}.

dequeue({[], []}) -> {empty, {[], []}};
dequeue({In, [H | T]}) -> {H, {In, T}};
dequeue({In, []}) -> dequeue({[], lists:reverse(In)}).

examples.descEn: Learn the quick sort algorithm by partitioning the list around a pivot.
examples.code:
%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    List = [10, 7, 8, 9, 1, 5],
    Sorted = quick_sort(List),
    io:format("Sorted list: ~p~n", [Sorted]).

quick_sort([]) -> [];
quick_sort([Pivot | Rest]) ->
    {Less, Greater} = partition(Pivot, Rest, [], []),
    quick_sort(Less) ++ [Pivot] ++ quick_sort(Greater).

partition(_, [], Less, Greater) -> {Less, Greater};
partition(Pivot, [Head | Tail], Less, Greater) ->
    if
        Head =< Pivot -> partition(Pivot, Tail, [Head | Less], Greater);
        true -> partition(Pivot, Tail, Less, [Head | Greater])
    end.

examples.descEn: Learn to read multiple lines until end-of-file (EOF) and print line count and word count.
examples.code:
%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    {Lines, Words} = read_all(0, 0),
    io:format("Lines: ~p~nWords: ~p~n", [Lines, Words]).

read_all(LineCount, WordCount) ->
    case io:get_line("") of
        eof -> {LineCount, WordCount};
        Line ->
            Trimmed = string:trim(Line),
            case Trimmed of
                "" -> read_all(LineCount + 1, WordCount);
                _ ->
                    Tokens = string:split(Trimmed, " ", all),
                    read_all(LineCount + 1, WordCount + length(Tokens))
            end
    end.
examples.stdin:
hello world
foo bar baz
last

examples.descEn: Learn to use a list as a set with union, intersection, and difference operations.
examples.code:
%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    A = [1, 2, 3],
    B = [3, 4, 5],
    io:format("Union: ~p~n", [union(A, B)]),
    io:format("Intersection: ~p~n", [intersection(A, B)]),
    io:format("Difference A-B: ~p~n", [difference(A, B)]).

union(A, B) -> lists:usort(A ++ B).

intersection(A, B) -> [X || X <- A, lists:member(X, B)].

difference(A, B) -> [X || X <- A, not lists:member(X, B)].

%% coding: utf-8
-module(main).
-export([main/1]).

main(_) ->
    io:setopts(standard_io, [{encoding, unicode}]),
    List = add(3, add(2, add(1, nil))),
    io:format("List: "),

    io:format("~n").

add(Val, nil) -> {node, Val, nil};
add(Val, {node, _, _} = Rest) -> {node, Val, Rest}.

print(nil) -> ok;
print({node, Val, Rest}) ->
    io:format("~p ", [Val]),
    print(Rest).

    hanoi(N-1, From, Aux, To),
